name: ocean-procession
title: Ocean Procession
description: A fleet of fully modeled sailboats crosses a smooth many-octave sea, pitching and rolling through reflected sky, refracted light, caustics, foam, and wakes.
controls: Move horizontally to orbit · Move vertically to dive and zoom
techniques: differentiable directional waves · stable Newton intersection · analytic buoyancy · ray-traced sailboats · Fresnel reflection and refraction
